case: Russia–China gas bargaining: eastern-route implementation and successive western/PS2 negotiations
scope_note: Read scope is not download scope. Original commercial contracts, MOU clauses and negotiation instructions were not obtained. Corporate mirrors and wire summaries are explicitly linked to their originating source chains. All preserved full texts remain outside Git.

sources.title: Gazprom, CNPC Agree on Gas Supply Terms
sources.creator: Anatoly Medetsky, The Moscow Times
sources.read_scope: Complete substantive article, closing paragraph included.
sources.provenance_and_independence: Original newspaper report, Gazprom spokesman and company statement; not a CNPC account.
sources.evidentiary_use: Leader-witnessed principal-terms agreement before Crimea; price excluded; year-end target.
sources.limitations: Underlying signed principal-terms text unavailable.

sources.title: Russia, China Still Haggling on Gas Price as Putin Arrives in Beijing
sources.creator: The Moscow Times (PDF byline)
sources.read_scope: Complete two-page PDF, including second-page continuation; photo not analyzed.
sources.provenance_and_independence: Publisher PDF. Cache filename begins reuters but PDF credits The Moscow Times; wire authorship not independently established.
sources.evidentiary_use: Price still unresolved on first day of visit; Peskov and company statements; reported prepayment difficulties.
sources.limitations: Anonymous company-source claims are not Chinese instructions.

sources.title: Replies to journalists’ questions following a visit to China
sources.creator: President of Russia / Vladimir Putin
sources.read_scope: Complete transcript, including intervening Ukraine questions and final Peskov-prompted correction to pricing formula; timestamp 15:40 Shanghai.
sources.provenance_and_independence: Official English translation of Putin public account, not joint negotiated minutes.
sources.evidentiary_use: Mutual compromise, overnight negotiations, government decisions still required, investment estimates, oil/petroleum-basket linkage.
sources.limitations: Formula coefficients and contract itself undisclosed; self-presentation cannot allocate concessions.

sources.title: 中俄签署两项重要能源合作协议
sources.creator: 新华社 安蓓、王希、刘华; 国家能源局转载

sources.provenance_and_independence: Chinese government-hosted report of May 21 CNPC–Gazprom signing, not contract text.

sources.limitations: Planned start is not proof of final contractual commencement or breach.

sources.evidentiary_use: Contemporary sanctions/summit context; anonymous price-floor report; competing assessments of deal economics.

sources.title: Gas contract with China worth $400 bln over 30 years - Gazprom CEO

sources.title: Sino-Russian Gas and Oil Cooperation: Entering into a New Era of Strategic Partnership? (WPM 59)

sources.title: Gazprom and CNPC sign agreement to supply Russian pipeline gas to China via Far Eastern route
sources.creator: Gazprom; Europétrole corporate-release mirror
sources.read_scope: Complete release and Notes read; corporate boilerplate also seen. Original Gazprom indexed release separately read.
sources.provenance_and_independence: Mirror explicitly credits Communiqué GAZPROM; original https://www.gazprom.com/press/news/2022/february/article547478/ timed out.

sources.title: Russia and China Expand Their Gas Deal: Key Implications
sources.creator: Vitaly Yermakov and Michal Meidan, Oxford Institute for Energy Studies
sources.read_scope: FULL READ: all 13 PDF pages, notes 1–30, seven figures. All figures visually inspected on PDF pp. 3,6,8,9,10,11,12.
sources.provenance_and_independence: Original OIES PDF; distinguishes technical projects, Chinese demand constraints and commercial options.
sources.evidentiary_use: Geographic nonfungibility, Mongolia-route economics, need for new supply agreement, competing demand and supply scenarios.
sources.limitations: Forecasts not realized outcomes; price slope/lag explicitly estimates in note 10. Figure 1 labels older Altai route Power of Siberia 2, unlike Mongolia route in main text; Far East duration differs from some reporting and is not used.

access_limits: Gazprom main-site origin pages repeatedly timed out; corporate RNS/Europétrole republications used and labeled.
FT June 2024 original full text unavailable; Reuters summary is the same reporting chain.
SCMP September 2026 public portion only; no full-read claim.
No published 2014 price coefficients, signed prepayment contract,2025 construction MOU, PS2 sales agreement, final investment decision or final financing package acquired.
CNPC September 7,2026 company-paper item discovered but retrieval failed; not used as substantive evidence.
A generic 2026 aggregator was rejected in favor of direct Interfax reports.
